name: Cultist: Strength of the Black Empire transforms on Dreadnought ranks (#7632)
contract: Strength of the Black Empire 680557 (level 40 passive) promises Dreadnought sheds the caster's mortal form into a void monstrosity. Delivery is the 680556 helper, enabled by the Cultist Refresh only while the caster holds 680557 and an aura of ranked spell 567524 (Unit::GetAuraOfRankedSpell walks the spell_ranks chain). Dreadnought's server ranks 567524/567548/567549/567550/567551/567552 were never chained, so the lookup only matched the exact rank-1 aura while the talent needs level 40 (rank 4+): the helper never applied and nothing transformed. A level 49 Cultist at 90 Insanity (Dreadnought rank 4 needs the 80-Insanity marker 680604 as its caster aura) casting Dreadnought rank 4 (567550) must gain helper 680556 and display 28844 (creature_template 250043, retargeted at load by the class contracts). The display assertion also pins the template/model path, not just aura presence.

steps.label: SETUP: the Dreadnought cast itself did not fail
Strength of the Black Empire applies its void-monstrosity helper - fails before the fix, when no helper aura appears
The caster shows the void-monstrosity display 28844 - fails before the fix, when the mortal form stays
The void monstrosity is scaled down to Herald parity instead of filling the screen
